summary: Steam catalog enumeration comes from Valve's keyless store services (IStoreQueryService/IStoreBrowseService/IStoreService), and Steam identity comes from the Steam store link RAWG records for the game, not from title matching.
reason: The partner-documented catalog endpoint (IStoreService/GetAppList) needs a Steam Web API key, cannot filter by demo, tag, or price, and has no demo listing at all; the store services answer keyless and take country_code/language. The storefront storesearch endpoint is capped at 10 results with no paging, so the old title-only resolver both could not enumerate anything and failed on remake titles such as DOOM (2016), whose Steam name is plain DOOM. Any regen that keeps only storesearch/appdetails/appreviews loses enumeration and reintroduces that class of failure.
validated_outcome: publish validate PASS; new offline tests pass (catalog taxonomy/encoding/decoding/resolution plus country precedence). Live: `steam browse --type demo --free` reports a real total with next_page, `steam app "DOOM (2016)"` resolves to appid 379720, and `ratings` reports steam_resolved_by=rawg-store-link. MCP surface went 65 -> 68 tools with nothing removed.
